reviewers.summary: Verbatim token port is exact (24 color + 2 font tokens, both themes), Tailwind 4 @custom-variant/@theme-inline wiring correct and building, fonts self-hosted and consumed; only a low advisory on sub-AA faint/accent contrast for downstream usage.

findings.summary: --faint (#9a9a91 on --bg #fbfbfa) is ~2.7:1 and --accent-on-bg ~3.7:1, both below WCAG AA for normal text; these pairs were not in the design.md verified set (fg/bg, fg/panel, muted/bg all pass). Values are a correct verbatim port of the frozen DESIGN §3 tokens, so this is inherited from the design, not a porting error. No component consumes --faint yet.
findings.recommendation: Track as a token-usage constraint: downstream components must not use --faint (or accent-colored) text for meaningful small copy, or must pair it with a non-color cue and/or a larger size. Do NOT silently mutate the frozen DESIGN §3 value here; if a fix is wanted it is a design-source decision tuned in globals.css only. Surfaced in CURRENT_STATE + the QA test plan.

reviewers.summary: openspec validate --strict PASS; TC-STACK-02 / TC-STACK-03 / NFR-A11Y-02 all implemented + covered — tokens verbatim from DESIGN §3, next/font @font-face emits literal Inter/JetBrains Mono names so var(--sans/--mono) self-host correctly, dark: reconciled via @custom-variant on [data-theme="dark"], focus/reduced-motion present, build + app/ lint + 25 tests green, no scope drift.

CSS token foundation + font/theme wiring only; next/font self-hosts (no runtime Google Fonts request / IP leak), no network/storage/trackers/cookies/sinks, no new deps — BC-PRIVACY-01 / TC-DATA-01 hold. suppressHydrationWarning use is benign.
